claims.text: If run exactly as specified, this design decides: Measured on one rented A100 SXM4 40 GB box, the production throughput (ns/day) of the card's own protocol (LOPLS-AA, 250-molecule nonylcyclohexane box of 11,250 atoms, 313.15 K, 2 fs, PPPM 1e-5, SHAKE on C-H, pressure tensor and heat flux sampled every 5 steps; LAMMPS 2024.08.29 conda-forge CUDA build, GPU package), substituted for the card's PROXY 250 ns/day, reads the card's p_bench gate (>= 150 ns/day) and re-prices the card's USD 941 plan; the liquid density after equilibration is checked against the reference 0.805 g/cm3 within 4% first.. Endpoints: E1 pre-launch build: builder exit code at 0.3 g/cm3; |net_charge_per_molecule| from metadata.json; zero-step read_data in CPU LAMMPS; atom count at exit 0 AND |net charge| < 1e-3 e AND read_data without error AND 11,250 atoms, refuted by any failure: no launch (the pilot's halt stands at this density too); recorded as the run's outcome; E2 anchor: NPT mean density over the last 250 ps (the deck's density file) against the reference 0.805 g/cm3 at within +/-4%, refuted by outside: production rows labelled 'descriptive only; anchor failed'; E3 to E5 still reported as step rates with that label; Claim B and C read NOT_READ; E3 card PROXY throughput_ns_day = 250: ns/day of prod_a (deck as written) on one A100, from the Performance line at holds if within [100, 625] ns/day, refuted by outside: the PROXY is off by more than 2.5x (direction reported); E3b card gate p_bench: measured ns/day >= 150 at pass if >= 150, refuted by fail: the card's own text applies, 'drop the extension tier and re-plan with 48 molecules at 3 replicas'; E3c card plan re-priced: USD 941 x 250 / measured ns/day (GPU-hour lines scale with 1/throughput; storage line held) at within the card's USD 1,000 cap if measured >= 235.3, refuted by above the cap: the plan is under-priced by the reported ratio; not a card prediction, a cost reading; E4 prod_b (pressure tensor only) ns/day and ratio E4/E3 at report, refuted by none (descriptive); E5 prod_c (no per-step sampling) ns/day and ratio E5/E3; per-atom step rate (atom-steps per second) at report, refuted by none (descriptive); the ratio prices the sampling the Amber proxy lacks; E6 compatibility: does the deck as written run with the GPU package at RUNS or REFUSED with the error line, refuted by REFUSED: E3 reads prod_b with the label 'viscosity-only protocol'; the card's thermal-conductivity arm is flagged unpriced on the GPU; E7 install and build readings: LAMMPS install wall-clock on the box; builder wall-clock on the workstation; dry-run success at report against the card's l_dry line (4 h time box), refuted by none (descriptive); E8 sanity control: temperature within 313.15 +/- 5 K over each production segment; no error or lost-atom lines at all pass, refuted by any fail: that segment's row is 'descriptive only; unstable run' and E3 is not read from it.

instruments.asserts: E1 pre-launch build: builder exit code at 0.3 g/cm3; |net_charge_per_molecule| from metadata.json; zero-step read_data in CPU LAMMPS; atom count
E2 anchor: NPT mean density over the last 250 ps (the deck's density file) against the reference 0.805 g/cm3
E3 card PROXY throughput_ns_day = 250: ns/day of prod_a (deck as written) on one A100, from the Performance line
E3b card gate p_bench: measured ns/day >= 150
E3c card plan re-priced: USD 941 x 250 / measured ns/day (GPU-hour lines scale with 1/throughput; storage line held)
E4 prod_b (pressure tensor only) ns/day and ratio E4/E3
E5 prod_c (no per-step sampling) ns/day and ratio E5/E3; per-atom step rate (atom-steps per second)
E6 compatibility: does the deck as written run with the GPU package
E7 install and build readings: LAMMPS install wall-clock on the box; builder wall-clock on the workstation; dry-run success
E8 sanity control: temperature within 313.15 +/- 5 K over each production segment; no error or lost-atom lines
